narrative.intro: Fedex Supply Chain Distribution System has $102M in federal contract obligations in FY27 to date. The company has 7 awards this fiscal year and an average award size of $14.6M. Obligations fell 75.0% year over year. Federal obligations to Fedex Supply Chain Distribution System peaked in recent years and then declined: FY22 obligations were $253M. FY23 obligations were $293M. FY24 obligations were $342M. FY25 obligations were $381M. FY26 obligations were $409M. FY27 obligations are $102M. The current-year totals are partial and represent fiscal year to date activity. Use these figures to compare procurement momentum and to size business development efforts against prior-year obligation levels.
